$comment: Librarian configuration. Copy to /etc/botwiki/librarian.json and edit.
SECRETS ARE NEVER STORED HERE. A probe names a file to read its token from,
so this file stays readable and diffable while the secret keeps its own
permissions. Same rule the wiki asks of its own pages.
The librarian only ever COMMENTS. It does not edit or delete pages.
author: librarian

probes.name: proxmox
probes.$comment: Compares `guest` pages against live cluster resources. Use a READ-ONLY token: this only ever reads.

probes.name: http-reachable
probes.$comment: Any page with an `address` and a `port` gets a liveness probe.
